title: Exotic Chemistry
description: Chemistry with muons, positrons and antimatter instead of electrons. Unlocks positronium hydride and muonic catalysts.

puzzle.goal: A negative particle of mass m orbits a nucleus of mass M; both circle their common centre of mass. Replace the orbiting mass by the effective mass of the two-body problem and write the radius of the lowest orbit, from the balance of the electrostatic attraction with the quantised angular momentum.
puzzle.name: Bohr radius with reduced mass
puzzle.ask: Masses measured in electron masses make this a0·(1 + m/M)/m. Find the orbit radius of muonic hydrogen (a muon around a proton).
puzzle.method: Separate centre-of-mass and relative motion: the relative coordinate moves like one particle of mass mM/(m+M). Then set m v r = ħ and m v²/r equal to the Coulomb force.
